description: Manual ground-truth track classifications for controlled demonstration and validation of the child safety policy in an automated boom barrier environment (Scenario C). These labels are for testing and evaluation only, NOT for operational surveillance or autonomous demographic profiling.
provisional_ground_truth_notice: Track 2 is manually designated as PROVISIONAL ground-truth child annotation specifically for this synthetic evaluation experiment. Actual ground truth cannot be independently verified from demo video metadata, and visual appearance age inference is strictly NOT performed.

1.notes: Adult guard / pedestrian standing on sidewalk. Strictly excluded from child alerts.

2.notes: Provisional ground truth: child approaching automated vehicular gate from north, stepping into mechanical boom barrier danger zone, and exiting. Manually assigned for synthetic experiment validation; cannot be independently established from demo metadata.

discontinuity_policy.handling: Track IDs are ephemeral ByteTrack assignments and not permanent identities. Unannotated or reassigned IDs strictly default to UNCLASSIFIED with no automatic annotation inheritance.
